name: Home Doctor
description: Daily Home Doctor pass: probe independent Hermes vs Home Assistant healthchecks, then enqueue [heal] tasks for affected systems via apple-tasks MCP. EventKit has no hourly recurrence — daily at 08:00 is the standing schedule.
title: Home Doctor: inspect Hermes, Home Assistant, and enqueue heals
notes:
Probe, then enqueue heals via apple-tasks MCP doctor(enqueue_heals: true). Do not fix HA/Hermes/dispatch yourself — specialist [heal] tasks go to launchd.

Independent signals: homeAssistant (HA HTTP API), Hermes (binary/gateway/cron), hermesHaLink (adapter). HA compose is ~/Documents/home-lab/compose.yaml.
Never print secrets. Do not toggle Home Assistant entities. Do not call dispatch_run.
Complete the doctor task when enqueue finishes so the daily series rolls forward.
